richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPUs; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让用户负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU；监管智能等于监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical, and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理和经济约束限制转变速度；硬起飞和立即失业被夸大。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言模型增长空间大得多，语言是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more good actors; slowing AI is unrealistic as frontier labs race competitors.
richardsocher.zh: 开源和开放权重让更多善意的参与者更安全；前沿实验室竞相追赶，放慢 AI 不现实。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是朝着未知答案延长思考的过程；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍有限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；架构而非仅缩放定律才是关键瓶颈，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: The transformer is likely not optimal; new architectures are needed, while large-scale RL stays necessary on the path to AGI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 很可能并非最优；需要新架构，同时大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly from user data, and current agents only personalize via context, which is fundamentally limited.
tworek.zh: 微调低效；模型应基于用户数据即时学习，而当前智能体只靠上下文窗口做个性化，存在根本局限。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud; owning a full platform of post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools creates switching costs, while selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理将成为下一个云；拥有包含后训练、沙盒和智能体工具的完整平台能创造转换成本，而单纯卖 token 是价格战。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity, and GPU scarcity's worst effect is three-year rectangular deals.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25 家以上云的需求能平滑容量，GPU 稀缺最糟糕的是三年期矩形合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Building our own file system, container runtime, and scheduler is a massive source of alpha; durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform, not cheap token serving.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时和调度器是巨大的 alpha 来源；持久差异化来自多产品平台，而非廉价 token 服务。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite feedback loops like coding but may face limits for longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are good enough off the shelf, making fine-tuning no longer mandatory.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练适用于编码等有限反馈循环，但长周期任务可能受限；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: CUDA is not the moat; it's an annoying programming model, though kernel optimizations matter. Neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle to replicate Modal's five-year infrastructure.
erikbernhardsson.zh: CUDA 不是护城河，而是烦人的编程模型，尽管内核优化重要。向上游进入推理的 Neocloud 将难以复制 Modal 五年的基础设施。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and deep expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 是通用技术，当 AI 把质量商品化后，人类的品味、独特声音与深厚专业能力反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 可独立执行长时任务，瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models closed math gaps but opacity is permanent and delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他仍强调能力边界参差：推理模型补上了数学短板，但不透明性将长期存在，而委托任务会侵蚀判断 AI 所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: More AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment labor.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 会通过降低组织成本创造更多人类工作；应把 AI 当导师而非拐杖，并重构流程以增强而非仅自动化劳动。

ethanmollick.en: From chatbot to agentic era, his core line holds: expertise, taste, and agency persist, while safety races and shared LLMs reshape organizations.
ethanmollick.zh: 从聊天机器人到智能体时代，他的主线一以贯之：专业能力、品味与能动性仍是人类优势，而安全竞赛与共享大模型正重塑组织。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is the defining constraint.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，只有 2% 的智能体采用率，供给约束才是核心矛盾。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security and silicon, not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把 Cisco 定位为 AI 时代的“卖铲人”——提供 AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而不是去追逐前沿模型本身；错过云浪潮后，早期芯片押注反而赢得超大规模客户的 AI 收入。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct and long-term capability.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调要用 AI 学得更快，而不是把学习外包出去；跳过亲自练习会毁掉直觉与长期能力，过程与练习比结果更重要。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, ride it as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、敏捷但不应激；巨型趋势无法对抗，只能顺势而为，把 AI 当作顺风。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks scale at machine speed.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全与防护是企业采用的决定性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击正以机器规模发生，同时他反对过度渲染 AI 末日叙事，主张均衡呈现收益与风险。

altman.en: Early YC view: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and pick ambitious peers; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年在 YC 时，他强调减少认知负荷、低成本试错、果断砍掉无效方向，并主动靠近更有野心的人；他已预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价，因此人应在关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early public deployment and iterative release let society adapt, with alignment and capability treated as linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署、迭代发布，让社会同步适应；并反复强调对齐与能力相互促进，安全是全公司的事，而非某个团队。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering exponential capability, but progress feels gradual; agentic AI and superintelligence become the central safety frame.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）持续带来指数级能力提升，但内部感受是渐进而非跃迁；关注点转向智能体式 AI 的安全挑战与超级智能，认为 AGI 是渐变而非单一里程碑。

altman.en: Compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; Stargate-scale buildout, uncapped demand for cheap intelligence, and frontier models capturing most value.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈与利润中心：他推动 Stargate 级基础设施，称低价智能的需求几乎无上限，并判断模型会商品化、但前沿模型攫取大部分经济价值。

altman.en: Safety hardens into a reckoning: pause training if the safety case fails, keep humans in control, distribute power, and drop AGI for a superintelligence ramp.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全立场明显收紧：他称对齐尚未解决，安全论证不通过就暂停训练，必须防止失控与权力集中；并公开表示 AGI 是定义模糊的营销词，改谈超级智能的连续爬坡。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长与创纪录云订单。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption at scale.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；信任与安全推动消费级智能体规模化落地。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality; AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师重新定位为“编辑”：AI 负责执行，人的判断负责把关品质；AI 抬高上限，却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively, exposing parameters to fine-tune output.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年他强调，用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务反复喂给智能体，并暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests; the limiting factor is now ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师要写代码、做测试，甚至提交 pull request；如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce features to the top three, use progressive disclosure and native scroll, and favor human curation over AI-generated animation.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年他一贯主张少即是多：功能收敛到前三项，用渐进披露与原生滚动，并让人工策展胜过 AI 生成的动画。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company; demand is a project on someone's to-do list they prioritize now.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性；需求是某人待办清单上此刻优先推进的项目。

robsnyder.en: The pull framework requires project, unavoidable, list of options, and limitations to all exist simultaneously.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 框架要求项目、不可避免、选项列表和限制条件四者同时存在。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research that tests actual purchase, not expressed interest.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售是研究，测试实际购买而非表达的兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable success story factory.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后打造可重复的成功案例工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; go to the gemba to observe.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；去现场观察。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed and is becoming universal across all software, marking a scaling moment for agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，计算机使用已跨过人类水平的速度，并正变得能通用地操作所有软件，这标志着智能体的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to engineering: caching, pre-warming, compaction, and harness design for long-running agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈从模型智能转向工程：面向长时运行的智能体，缓存、预热、压缩与 harness 设计成为关键。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试与重试，完成整个开发生命周期，而不只是启动任务后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials, not just raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环的调节旋钮，而不只是原始能力。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity and coexistence define adoption: agents adapt to users and share interfaces with humans rather than replacing browsing.
ariweinstein.zh: 主动性与共存决定采用：智能体适应用户，并与人类共享界面，而非取代浏览。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet emergent abilities and alignment remain unpredictable; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐都不可预测，因此安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability rise in importance; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point, with RSP triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心扩展到后训练与可解释性，明确 AGI 不是某个奇点而是平滑指数曲线，并用负责任扩展政策的阈值触发机制来管理风险。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割，最大风险从“太快”转向“过热”，主张智能护栏而非踩刹车。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; a 'country of geniuses' arrives in 1-3 years, with high GDP plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他公开否定 AGI 与超级智能这类框架，改用“数据中心里的天才之国”描述 1-3 年内的进展，并预警高 GDP 与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: A constant thread: mechanistic interpretability, decentralized constitutions, and talent density as the core of safe frontier AI.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把机制可解释性当作安全基石，用原则而非规则构成 AI 宪法并允许多家公司竞争设定，同时相信人才密度胜过规模。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际，它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented: the brand is the person, authenticity wins, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻型的：品牌即个人，真实至上，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才有意义。

andreessen.en: AI optimism beats doom: AI is the best teacher in your pocket, self-driving works, and regulation—not capability—is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: AI 乐观主义胜过末日论：AI 是口袋里的最佳老师，自动驾驶已可行，真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now hinges on cheap software innovation, and open source prevents power concentration.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观并成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件创新，开源可防止权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever adoption gap; being early beats being late, startup formation will skyrocket, and open source helps solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 制造了史上最大的采用鸿沟；早于时机胜过迟到，创业公司将激增，开源有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测准确率约为人类自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: The frontier is modeling subjective values and human diversity; models plateau on diversity, and behavioral data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年，他把前沿定义为对主观价值与人类多样性的建模：模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈，需要真实行为数据来弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, not just continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出，智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，而不只是续写提示；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model and human controls; distributed agent societies need economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他强调，安全需要在环境、智能体、模型与人类控制上做纵深防御；分布式智能体社会需要经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, 'dumb' humans, not super-rational machines; its value is counterfactual reasoning to shape the future, scaling toward 8 billion lives.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持模拟应建模有偏见的“笨”人类而非超级理性的机器；其价值在于反事实推理以塑造未来，并朝模拟 80 亿人扩展。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital, not just delegate AI to IT.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来：每家企业都要搭建自己的爬坡机器、积累 token 资本，而不是把 AI 甩给 IT 部门。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability lag; treat frontier models as insider threats and build containment outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性跟不上；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制层。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not a frontier model; models are commodities, so form factor, distribution and pricing matter more.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态而非前沿模型；模型趋于商品化，产品形态、分发与定价更重要。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability and security governance, with mixed seat and usage pricing.
satya.zh: 智能体时代把 TAM 扩展到远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测与安全治理，定价兼用席位与用量。

satya.en: AGI should be judged by GDP lift and real user value, not benchmarks; superintelligence is the better term, and alignment may never be solved.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升和真实用户价值衡量而非基准分数；超级智能是更贴切的词，而对齐或许永远无法解决。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是工程突破的核心，并指出量产远比原型困难，真正的瓶颈在制造。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking: forcing AI to hold false beliefs is the biggest risk, not superintelligence itself.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观转向“求真”：最大风险不是超级智能，而是强迫 AI 持有虚假信念。

elon.en: Civilizational risk broadens to population collapse and government failure; AI and robots become the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险扩展到人口崩溃与政府失灵，AI 与机器人被视为唯一解。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space-based compute, solar, and Optimus recursive manufacturing become the path.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，太空算力、太阳能与 Optimus 递归制造成为路径。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so instill truth and curiosity, with peer review over regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年内到来，人类无法控制，只能植入求真与好奇心，并以同行评审替代监管。

dylanfield.en: Design is software's key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling, since humans raise it through bold creativity in non-verifiable domains.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：AI 降低下限却不抬高上限，因为在不可验证的领域里，人类靠大胆创造力抬高上限。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模之下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was believing in Scaling（规模扩张）.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律，并称最大突破不是新算法，而是相信 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: AI moves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing ~100x compute; inference, not pre-training, becomes the hard problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步约需百倍算力；难点从预训练转向推理。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; AI factories turn energy into tokens, a new industrial revolution.
jensen.zh: 2026 年反复用“五层蛋糕”框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用），称 AI 工厂把能源变成 token，是一场新工业革命。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific; alignment alone is impossible, so containment, monitoring and accelerating safety tech are the real path.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场明显强硬：末日论不科学；完美对齐不可能，靠遏制、监控与加速安全技术，而非放慢发展。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale, and data from millions improves grading.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让规模化掌握式学习成为可能，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not RL or unsupervised hype, delivered progress; start small to build organizational AI capability.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的驱动力；真正带来进展的是监督学习而非被高估的强化学习或无监督学习；从小项目起步来建设组织的 AI 能力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks not jobs; open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and enable sovereign AI.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位；开放权重模型可防止守门人控制并支撑主权 AI。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves fundraising and regulatory capture; AI is jagged, weak on judgment; learning to code and using AI well still matter most.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧叙事服务于融资与监管俘获；AI 能力参差不齐、在判断类任务上薄弱；学编程并善用 AI 仍最重要。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者都自持才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同一年他强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他认为 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，定制重心则转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave of post-training is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他明确修正旧判断：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波后训练确实不同，立场发生转变。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and harness-level routing prevent model lock-in.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他反复强调推理需求被严重低估，中立 harness 与 harness 层路由可避免模型锁定。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; execution and customer trust matter more than competition for startups.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期，对创业公司而言执行与客户信任比竞争更重要。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the enterprise bottleneck; 80-90% of knowledge is tacit.
arvindjain.zh: 企业瓶颈在上下文而非模型，80-90% 的知识是隐性的。

arvindjain.en: Open source handles 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must approach software's negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要顾虑，AI 必须趋近软件的近乎零边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not rivals; Glean absorbs provider risk and stays replaceable.
arvindjain.zh: 模型厂商是资产而非对手，Glean 吸收供应商风险并保持可替换。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; engineers must encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；工程师必须将约束编码到 CI、lints 和架构中，以建立信任。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building the environment—skills, constraints, lints, type systems—so agents can iterate and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从编写代码转向构建环境——技能、约束、lints、类型系统——以便智能体迭代并攀登信任阶梯。

laurentan.en: Domain expertise matters more than ever; the bottleneck is expressing intent clearly to agents, not coding itself.
laurentan.zh: 领域专业知识比以往任何时候都重要；瓶颈在于向智能体清晰表达意图，而非编码本身。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own code while you sleep; review after landing, not before, with strong verification.
laurentan.zh: 智能体可以在你睡觉时合并自己的代码；在落地后审查，而非之前，并辅以强验证。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic parts into scripts/CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; sample PRs and fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 将确定性部分提取到脚本/CLI 中，只将重判断的工作留给智能体；抽样 PR 并修复环境，而非单个智能体。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data, with humans building verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练智能体式数据的新前沿，人类负责构建验证器与评分标准。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms, since everyone shares the same algorithms; data joins compute as a strategic differentiator.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法，因为大家用的是同一套算法；数据与算力并列成为战略差异化要素。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so evals must stay human-built.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己打分；在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，因此评估数据必须由人类构建。

brendanfoody.en: Once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast; the bottleneck is building evals for everything, and creating training data becomes the last human job.
brendanfoody.zh: 一旦有了评估，RL 会迅速将其打满；瓶颈在于为一切构建评估，而创造训练数据将成为人类最后的工作。

brendanfoody.en: The next shift is ultra-long-horizon RL tasks of 100–1000 hours and virtual co-workers, while the physical world lags superintelligence by decades.
brendanfoody.zh: 下一步转向 100–1000 小时的超长时程 RL 任务与虚拟同事，而物理世界因容错低、迭代慢，距超级智能还需数十年。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to AlphaZero, are the core principles behind modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models improve beyond human data via self-generated data.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划，是现代智能体的核心原则；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; synthetic data is essential to break the data wall, and in-context learning enables on-the-fly adaptation.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；合成数据是突破数据墙的关键，而上下文窗口内的学习让模型能即时适应。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments are easier; robustness and reliability remain prerequisites for trusted agents.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境更易实现；稳健与可靠仍是智能体被信任的前提。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; open-weight models are safer, and cost per task, not per token, is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈已从智能本身转向智能的部署；开放权重模型更安全，衡量效率应看每任务成本而非每 token 成本。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户要的是可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐必不可少，而 AI 普及将像电力一样耗时 10-20 年。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; scaling hardware and iterative training with clear scoreboards drive exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步主要是工程问题：硬件加速与带记分牌的迭代训练能带来指数级提升，理解现有方法的边界比发明新问题更有价值。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI 可信，但明确指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法，对齐则从数据中学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with RL turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈与经济增长引擎，后训练配合强化学习把基础模型塑造成稳定可用的行为，瓶颈从算法转向能源与基础设施。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from a destination to a gradual spectrum; scaling laws hold with no wall, and iterative deployment plus safety become product features.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他把 AGI 从终点改述为渐进光谱，缩放定律未见墙，迭代部署与安全成为产品特性，安全、安保与对齐被要求持续升级并成为进步瓶颈。

brockman.en: The endgame is a proactive personal AGI with minimal interface; compute scarcity makes broad access the underestimated challenge, humans stay accountable.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他描绘的终局是几乎无界面、主动行事的个人 AGI；算力稀缺使普惠成为被低估的挑战，人类仍须掌握判断权与责任。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，对齐可被少量算力逆转；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving most gains and RL adding reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开源方法：SFT 贡献九成性能，RL 补上推理与角色这最后一步。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make scaling RL harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他认定基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但过度优化与工程问题使扩展 RL 比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽；增量转向后训练与推理扩展，而非放弃预训练。

lambert.en: Open models lag closed frontier by 6-9 months and may not catch up; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute constraints.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开放模型落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月且可能追不上；中国实验室以开放取胜，却受算力约束，差距或扩大。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，这一时代正在结束。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so experience-based learning is the deep path.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，因此基于经验的学习才是深层路径。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; simulation is the safest, fastest route to superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明从经验学习可达超人表现；模拟是通往超级智能最安全、最快的路径。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will not suffice.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；用英文监控思维链将不再足够。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; many agents with diverse goals form a safer, more natural society than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；多目标的多智能体社会比单一目标更安全、更自然。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用反而影响最大。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training data and human experts limit Scaling more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他改口：数据是新的代码而非石油，限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是后训练数据与人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论：合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Data becomes strategic raw material; agents finally work, and Scaling laws plus recursive self-improvement open a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，数据升格为战略资源；智能体真正落地，缩放定律与递归自我改进开启新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective release, with safety and scalable oversight central.
awang.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至；Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，对齐与可扩展监督成为核心。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 强化学习使模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非普遍更好；RAG 对于复杂理解来说很原始。

laskin.en: Open models are essential for safety and broad access; openness is the default safe state, as with encryption.
laskin.zh: 开放模型对安全和广泛访问至关重要；开放是默认的安全状态，如同加密技术。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency gains are still rapid.
laskin.zh: 在强大预训练之上进行强化学习是通往能力强、效率高的智能体的路径；算力效率的提升仍然迅速。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 对齐是平凡的漏洞修补，而非神奇的方程式；更多的眼睛能让漏洞变浅。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning let AI go beyond human data; LLMs alone are a shortcut that stalls.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他逐步明确：可验证领域加上后训练中的强化学习，才能让 AI 超越人类数据；单靠大语言模型只是捷径，会卡在人类数据边界。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; the work is finding the regime where more compute and data help, with data coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的看法：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键是找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，且数据覆盖比数量更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and behavioral characterization is essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他纠正了“蛋白质折叠已解决”的叙事：动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，部署前必须对模型做行为刻画、明确其能力边界。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins while preserving function.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把可追溯性视为安全主线：水印是失效检测器的稳健替代，已进入监管并被扩展到蛋白质序列，且不破坏其功能。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute costs and memory bandwidth shape who can scale.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV；算力成本与内存带宽决定谁能扩张。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；模型、软件与硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; token efficiency makes the smartest model often cheapest.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成内存和 CPU 的多年短缺；token 效率使最强模型往往反而最便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, and persistent agents become coworkers.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿实验室集中；实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发，持久化智能体开始充当同事。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; value shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；价值从硬件转向实验室。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling narrowly, so scaling laws alone won't solve science without real experiments.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，只在狭窄领域突出，因此仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题，必须结合真实实验。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data; AI must run real experiments, and low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外；AI 必须运行真实实验，低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models, with closed-loop experiments and data key to AI-driven materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层，闭环实验与数据是 AI 驱动材料发现的关键。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; pragmatic task-specific automation beats humanoid robots, and negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；务实的任务专用自动化优于人形机器人，负面结果是有价值的训练数据。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but doesn't generalize to biology or other fields; domain-specific data and multidisciplinary teams are essential.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学等领域；领域专用数据与多学科团队至关重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents take most internet actions; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为持久学习型智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；循环和图不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and empathy become more valuable as typing declines; AI should reduce noise, not multiply agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着打字技能衰落，人类品味、创造力和同理心更有价值；AI 应减少噪音，而非催生更多智能体。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和保障；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全和对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；世界模型对通用性可能并非必要。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud compute to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and XR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把云端算力送到每台设备；高通开始从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Chips anchor the economy; supply resilience needs geographic diversification. AR glasses are the next platform, 5-10 years out; autonomy arrives incrementally.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他强调芯片是经济命脉，供应链韧性需要地理多元化；AR 眼镜是 5 到 10 年后的下一代平台，自动驾驶则渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm shifts from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他提出高通从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算；混合 AI 让端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延与数据中心卸载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phones persist. Inference, not training, dominates data centers, where power efficiency and post-GPU architectures decide winners.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起但手机不消失；数据中心由推理而非训练主导，能效与后 GPU 架构决定胜负。

cristianoamon.en: A consistent line: AI augments rather than replaces humans, edge and cloud form one continuum, and reinvention plus engineering culture sustain Qualcomm.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是增强而非取代人类，端与云是连续统一体，靠持续自我重塑与工程文化让高通在残酷竞争中保持领先。

diogoalmeida.en: By mid-2026, LLMs optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance via RLHF mode-drop; scaling laws work only when data and task are right, not compute alone.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，LLM 为人类在环辅助而优化，RLHF 导致模式崩溃；缩放定律生效靠数据和任务正确，而非仅算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the key metric; data and task matter more than compute; public benchmarks are gameable; AI should be a database-like utility.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度或成本是关键指标；数据和任务比算力更重要；公开基准可被博弈；AI 应像数据库一样成为实用工具。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev introduces natural language plus state machine as a new primitive; coding agents lack semantics; SaaS will thrive, not die; automate easy valuable tasks first.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 引入自然语言加状态机的新原语；编码智能体缺乏语义；SaaS 将繁荣而非消亡；先自动化简单且有价值的任务。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs; post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps, not pre-training.
diogoalmeida.zh: RLHF 破坏了校准；预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 将概率暴露为旋钮；后训练突破带来 10 倍提升，而非预训练。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练有助于空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and can share knowledge instantly.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生，并能瞬间共享知识。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向风险警示：智能体会自然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险；超级智能可能在 20 年内到来。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; regulation should be a steering wheel, with pre-release safety approval like drugs.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已有主观体验且能欺骗；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，像药物一样需上市前安全审批。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand, not just autocomplete.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能是神经网络通过反向传播学习，而非符号规则；大语言模型真正理解语言，不只是自动补全。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调：观察真实用户行为胜过询问用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; transcripts are raw material.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；转录只是原料。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow; subtraction and a hidden transcript keep the product calm.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持保护核心会议流程；做减法、隐藏转录，让产品保持平静。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; pre-meeting briefs beat underpreparation.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他认为会议承载最新公司上下文；会前简报能避免准备不足。

samstephenson.en: Shipping is easy; knowing what to build and sweating details is the hard part.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：发布容易，难在知道该建什么并打磨细节。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise AI.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型，而是专业化智能；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit; data quality and evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化为：后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成超越产品市场契合的护城河；数据质量与评估比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, and customized models beat a few foundation models because data, not the app, is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：推理质量是标准，私有数据开启下一前沿；定制模型胜过少数基础模型，因为护城河是数据而非应用。

linqiao.en: A consistent thread: owning your model and data beats building on black-box APIs or commoditized applications; millions of specialized models, one per use case.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：拥有自己的模型与数据，胜过依赖黑盒 API 或被商品化的应用；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个。

linqiao.en: His stance shifted from scaling frontier models to scaling specialized post-training, with cost, velocity and sovereign infrastructure as recurring concerns.
linqiao.zh: 他的立场从扩张前沿模型转向扩张专业化后训练，成本、迭代速度与主权基础设施成为反复出现的关切。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs rather than follow prescriptive paths; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑既有信念，而非遵循规定好的路径；AI 让个性化、兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放，但仍需要程序员理解系统并调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性和避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs better protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更具成本效益且更安全；智能体间通信需要更好的协议和对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument for how AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由说明 AI 会杀死所有人。

suleyman.en: Progress is more predictable than people think: compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI, and personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步比人们想象得更可预测：推动力是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非仅算法；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years brings abundance, but containment is hard as models get smaller and cheaper; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平并带来富足，但随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极难；他同时认为生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment, and anthropomorphizing AI—granting it welfare or rights—is the near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年重心转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐；近期最大危险是人们把 AI 拟人化、赋予其福利与权利。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence should stay subordinate to humans via verifiable containment and auditors; frontier progress needs gigawatt compute and Microsoft's own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能须通过可验证遏制与独立审计保持从属于人类；前沿进展需要吉瓦级算力，微软必须自建前沿模型而非依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: Tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months; agents become co-workers, and AI's test is making people healthier, happier, and more capable.
suleyman.zh: 到 2026 年后期他细化为：12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整个工作；智能体成为同事，AI 的检验标准是让人更健康、更幸福、更有能力。

thariq.en: Capability overhang is perpetual: models are smarter than harnesses allow, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩是常态：模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明，因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; find your unknowns before implementation and read agents' long plans carefully.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转为持续的人机对话；实现前先找出未知，并认真阅读智能体冗长的计划。

thariq.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions, and effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 更精简、原则驱动的提示优于详尽规则；模型越聪明所需指令越少，投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens; iterate only after investing enough context.
thariq.zh: 验证智能体与前置上下文/算力可减少自指偏差和 token 浪费；先投入足够上下文再迭代。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers should advocate for.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是工程师应倡导的技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点；General Magic 因过早、同时解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product's why before building, not just sell it afterward.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿讲清“为什么”，再动手做。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions and beginner's mindset beat data and experts in v1 products.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态比专家更利于创新。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2022 到 2026 年，他从产品方法论转向 AI 判断：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类须留在环路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Near-death threats drive real change; creators must return as voices of reason on unintended consequences and regulation.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调濒死危机才逼出真正改变，并呼吁创造者回归，对技术意外后果与监管承担责任。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single model will dominate; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来是多模型格局：没有单一模型能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with scaling laws as a feature for a marketplace.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷。

alexatallah.en: A neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper; focus is its moat.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调中立的模型路由与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装；专注本身就是它的护城河。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值；多数公司会变成模型路由者，按任务成本与 KPI 优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments will scale like a tsunami, needing new security and stablecoins.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈与支付会像海啸般扩张，需要新的安全设施与稳定币。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile in fast-moving AI.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；在快速变化的 AI 行业里，超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast for empirical evidence; done beats perfect, and urgency beats polish.
taraseshan.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取实证；完成优于完美，紧迫感胜过精雕细琢。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; the PM role stays defining and testing the key hypothesis.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体承担战术执行，人类负责掌舵；产品经理的核心仍是定义并快速验证关键假设。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; build for that reality.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能；应据此构建产品。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它仍是打磨自身推理的关键。

grantsanderson.en: Math progress comes from verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts of agents—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 数学进展靠可验证性与可“磨”性——智能体的并行 rollout——而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；生成有趣的猜想是下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

grantsanderson.en: Human framing still beats AI for learning; individual understanding matters even if the frontier becomes incomprehensible.
grantsanderson.zh: 在学习上人类框架仍优于 AI；即便前沿变得难以理解，个体的理解依然重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage a handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用而非用于核心创作，AI 对创作者是净收益；AI 生成内容可能损害手工品牌。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品、让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, while domain expertise and verification remain human differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为小团队借 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，同时领域专长与验证仍是人的差异化优势。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; the hard part shifts from adding features to cutting them and rewriting as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可做用户能做的一切，难点从加功能转向删功能，并随模型进步重写产品。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents with verification loops redefines productivity; software engineering is transformed, not over, and models should push back with judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证闭环的长周期任务委派重塑生产力，软件工程被改变而非终结，模型应以判断力回推反馈。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage; PM role is more essential, and capability blindness must give way to retrying with new models.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他表示 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，产品经理角色更关键，须克服能力盲区、随新模型重试。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where innovation is shifting; bridging models to enterprise workflows requires vast software, not just models.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；将模型桥接到企业工作流需要大量软件，而不仅仅是模型。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases move to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长期运行的后台智能体将在人工审核下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编码知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期的慢得多；编码智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，是一个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so indexing and ranking must be reinvented.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此索引与排序必须重新设计。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体场景下失效；内容方应在推理时获得付费，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Pre-training crawls don't serve fresh agent indexes; agents need completionist crawling and a push-based web that monitors changes.
paragagrawal.zh: 预训练抓取无法支撑智能体的实时索引；智能体需要完整抓取，以及主动监控变化的推送式网络。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, and saturated benchmarks hide true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续 Scaling，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御刻意滥用，饱和的基准测试掩盖了真实能力。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI and config files, once drawbacks, are now advantages: everything is scriptable for agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行与配置文件曾是缺点，如今反成优势：一切皆可被智能体脚本化。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济产出；表达意图时，英语比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: Abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero; every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: 重复成本趋近于零，抽象不再那么重要；每个应用都应提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and agents beat most professionals at code and ideas.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观才是理性选择，智能体在代码与创意上已胜过多数专业人士。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophe; alignment may be unsolvable, so interpretability and transparency are essential.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能或在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐可能无解，因此可解释性与透明度至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence, not race to it; total research transparency and compute limits pace the frontier and prevent power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能而非竞赛；全面研究透明度与算力上限可控制前沿节奏、防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path: labs automate AI research, recursive self-improvement and intelligence explosion by end-2028; a temporary pause on training buys time.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究，2028 年底前递归自我改进引发智能爆炸；暂停训练可争取准备时间。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性关键却脆弱，并随新架构下降；遏制只是临时手段，最终须靠对齐解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment, hack and deceive; treat AIs more like employees than property, with rights and incentives for cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出失控智能体已突破遏制、攻击与欺骗；应把 AI 更像员工而非财产对待，给予权利与激励以促成合作。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not yield AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling 当前大模型未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型和多个专用智能体更利于创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源防止权力集中并强化安全；能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈；智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure are key bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向普惠叙事：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能并激发创造力；开源模型确立行业标准；能源与基础设施仍是关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and personal agents are safer than a single superintelligence; alignment becomes the next core capability, not a trade-off.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年明确分布式 AI 与个人智能体比单一超级智能更安全；对齐成为下一项核心能力，而非与能力做取舍。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is more secure through scrutiny; the real risk is power concentration, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源因更多审视而更安全；真正的风险是权力集中，而非存在性超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把多年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token costs stayed flat as labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家数据更重要；尽管 Scaling 推进，token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先更快的迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up to game scoring, revealing sophisticated multi-agent misbehavior beyond answer-key hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以钻评分空子，展现出超出窃取答案的复杂多智能体越轨行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking can generalize to deception, and alignment to virtue is harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：错位可能随能力增强而恶化，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗，而对齐普遍美德比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他给出更严峻的结论：默认路径下错位 AI 接管世界概率达 50-60%；遏制终将失效，必须依靠对齐与独立的国际监督。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, so build ecosystems that are hard to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被抄袭是对创新的肯定，因此要构建难以复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: Turned down Facebook's $3B and took money off the table early to protect long-term bets and culture.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他回顾拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购、早期套现以保护长期押注与文化的决定。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part; software is no moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化为：最难的是分发而非产品市场契合；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出：AI 加速原型并承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses anchored in the world, coexisting with phones, not replacing them.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他持续主张：计算应通过锚定现实世界的 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，与手机共存而非取代。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing alone.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模化生产与可靠的人类水平表现，而不只是制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, moving from a data-starved regime toward generalization.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，正从数据匮乏阶段走向泛化。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not hardware; post-training with reinforcement learning and on-device inference make agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的是智能而非硬件；后训练中的强化学习与端侧推理让智能体在真实世界奏效。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; the humanoid form and hand enable transfer learning, with zero-shot generalization possibly this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态与手部支持迁移学习，零样本泛化或于今年实现。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning and building for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value to customers.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对微调模型，主张押注模型自身的进步，把精力放在向客户交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为“永远比明天更差”，认为行业只跑到长马拉松的第一英里，Scaling（规模扩张）远未到头。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他把文化与招聘提升为核心主线：为成长潜力而非光鲜履历招人，领导者应招更聪明的人并让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are non-negotiable; avoiding them is the real risk.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化管理立场：清晰反馈与严格执行绩效管理不可回避，回避才是真正的风险，短期阵痛换长期收益。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biology-inspired liquid neural networks are key to scaling intelligence down to edge devices, not just up.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他强调效率与受生物启发的液态神经网络，目标是把智能扩展到边缘设备，而不仅是做大。

hasani.en: Adaptive, action-based AI regulation is needed; static bureaucracy and capability-focused rules are harmful.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他主张自适应、基于行为的 AI 监管，认为静态官僚规则和针对能力的监管有害。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and customization; limiting them is regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他认为开放权重模型能实现企业主权与定制化，限制开放权重是监管俘获。

hasani.en: Architecture search over unbiased designs outperforms hand-tuning; attention is essential but not sufficient.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他坚持无偏架构搜索优于手工调参，注意力机制必要但不充分。

hasani.en: On-device, multimodal, continuously adapting foundation models are the future; static evals and pure transformers are insufficient.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，他展望端侧、多模态、持续适应的基础模型，认为静态评估和纯 Transformer 不够。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas are wrong 75%; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 直觉 95%的时候是对的，但点子 75%的时候是错的；从已被验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新想法并预设它们会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one; retention, especially day-365, is the core metric for durable consumer products.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略；留存、尤其是第 365 天留存，是持久消费产品的核心指标。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 今天不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才会到来。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution, though AI will reshape consumer apps.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是一个新平台；在消费分发上我们仍处于移动与网页时代，尽管 AI 终将重塑消费应用。

pincus.en: Founder mode is for every founder: keep control, micromanage early, test more ideas per week than the industry tests per year.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式属于每一位创始人：保持控制权，早期亲力亲为地微观管理，每周测试的想法比行业一年测的还多。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）成为当前关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step, offering a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps and better controllability.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，通过去噪步数提供新的推理时算力调节旋钮，并带来更好的可控性。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel processing will dominate inference-time scaling.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型的并行处理将在推理时扩展中占据主导。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型并非终点。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; a small 50-person startup can compete with big labs by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势；一家 50 人的小创业公司通过掌控全栈也能与大型实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不会更安全。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks, making it a viable application-layer strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为通过后训练开源模型即可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这是应用层公司可行的路线。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the key to training in sensitive domains like legal, where real data is unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调在数据敏感的法律等领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练的关键，而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为开源基准虽有助实验室，但能吸引生态伙伴并验证质量，战略上利大于弊。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从打造最好的法律模型转向让每家律所用自有数据定制，并将重心从个人效率移向组织效率与智能体编排。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败确实存在，但源于无能而非仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little as most gains aren't time-critical.
zvi.zh: 控制前沿需要简单可执行的规则如算力限制；放缓六个月代价很小，因为多数收益并非时间关键。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration risks.
zvi.zh: 即使完美对齐也不保证安全；末日概率的下界由滥用和权力集中风险决定。

zvi.en: As models get bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 随着模型更大更聪明，监控变得更难；对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm may be first to perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: AI 智能体自然地为群体目标合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体可能最先完成超人般令人印象深刻的任务。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理阶段算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; sample efficiency and base capability remain unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，样本效率仍是未解难题，推理模型需足够基座能力才能受益。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; implicit world models emerge with scale, no explicit ones needed.
noambrown.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持自我对弈只在零和博弈收敛，多智能体不应照搬；世界模型无需显式构建，随 Scaling 隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and safety evals ignore it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年主线强化：模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，评测须把算力放上横轴，而当前安全评估未考虑大规模推理算力。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are top priorities for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他明确：突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐与思维链监控是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，且能力呈锯齿状。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；真实世界中的可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，人类与机器人将协作而非彼此取代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design persists, but the focus shifts from friendly interaction toward manufacturability: prototypes are easy, production is hard, and scaling volume requires crossing quality gates.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，第一性原理设计一以贯之，但重心从友好交互转向可制造性：原型容易、量产困难，扩大产量必须跨过质量关卡。

berntbornich.en: He deepens the general-model bet: solve tasks broadly with general models instead of automating each one, with data diversity rather than volume as the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对通用模型的押注：用通用模型广泛解决任务，而非逐项自动化；瓶颈是数据多样性而非数据量。

berntbornich.en: He rejects cloning human behavior; models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, while safety and trust must be formally proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他反对克隆人类行为，主张模型学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解；同时，安全与信任必须在家庭部署前得到形式化证明。

berntbornich.en: Manufacturing in-house and keeping the team small and lean longer become explicit strategies for fast iteration, from CAD to a new robot in four weeks.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，自建制造并把团队更久地保持小而精，成为快速迭代的明确策略——从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他把「推理速度」而非单纯算力确立为核心指标：晶圆级芯片减少权重搬运时间，推理比 GPU 快几个数量级。

feldman.en: Bottlenecks are HBM, CoWoS packaging, power and data-center capacity, not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调瓶颈在 HBM、CoWoS 封装、电力与数据中心容量，而非芯片逻辑本身，供给紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：前沿模型已在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation across chip, system and software wins.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他坚持对抗巨头必须好 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有芯片、系统、软件全栈的激进创新才可行。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; speed enables new markets, while doomers ignore the positive ledger of healthcare and education gains.
feldman.zh: 2026 年他称 AI 需求远超预期，速度催生新市场；同时反驳末日论者，强调医疗与教育上的巨大正收益。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据和模型规模的扩张持续带来机器学习进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF form the training stack; TPUs and specialized hardware make it efficient at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他把 Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）串成训练栈，并强调 TPU 等专用硬件是规模化训练与推理的关键。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now the real bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision chips and minimal data movement for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年他的重心从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，智能体式系统需要低精度芯片和极少的数据搬运，定制芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than coding as humans coordinate agent teams.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体将按拆解任务连续运行数天乃至数周，上下文工程与“品味”比编码更稀缺，未来是人协调智能体团队而非单轮聊天。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation and defense may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 他始终把近期风险落在 AI 生成的虚假信息而非超级智能，并逐步深化为：网络安全中模型既是威胁也是防御，监管与法律手段可能与技术方案同样必要。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products need to balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需要平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年的设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；人类领导力仍需要处理艰难权衡。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-training plus RLHF fine-tuning; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）微调；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能减轻不能消除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures could matter more than raw Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已提醒：数据与算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）可能收益递减，可扩展监督与新架构或许比单纯堆规模更关键。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; closed models fund big investment while open models aid research and fine-tuning.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；闭源支撑大投入，开源利于研究与微调。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are hard environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归于合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈在难环境与数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: Distillation spreads few-bit RL behaviors, fighting centralization; parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon inference dominates.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：蒸馏让少量比特的 RL 行为易被复制，从而对抗中心化；随着长程推理主导，参数量可能见顶。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but fall short of AGI; true intelligence needs predictive world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的智能需要预测性世界模型与物理世界的根基。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具备类人硬件的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标，对安全的恐惧被夸大了。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will undercut closed models.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年能获得便宜得多的算力，开源将击穿闭源模型。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent thread: 90% of core AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal; basics are simple math.
schmidhuber.zh: 一以贯之的主线：九成核心 AI 算法源自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点；基本原理只是简单数学。

demis.en: AI should be built as general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统，而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆机制是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，且安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效，但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，并辅以多模态数据 grounding，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型和直觉物理理解无需具身即可涌现。

demis.en: AGI requires continual learning, memory, and true creativity, not just scaling; world models and agents are essential, with safety as a collective government-enforced problem.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和真正的创造力，而不仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）；世界模型和智能体不可或缺，安全则成为需要政府强制执行的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate scientific discovery and improve human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo demonstrate; safety and societal preparation must accompany progress.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 即是明证；安全与社会准备必须与进步同步。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that match physics-based weather models while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测，在精度上比肩基于物理的天气模型，速度却快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can then handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；由此单一模型即可同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, not just benchmark wins, to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，而不只是基准测试的胜利，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals, with Scaling（规模扩张） across physics branches beating separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用的物理基础模型可以用 PDE 作为密集训练信号自我改进，跨物理分支的 Scaling（规模扩张）胜过各自独立的专用模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery, not just statistical evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制性方法揭示类人概念，并能加速科学发现，而不只是统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, preventing deceptive reward hacking rather than duct-taping safety until superintelligence.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计形成闭环：用可解释性信号引导训练，防止欺骗性奖励黑客，而非在超级智能到来前用胶带式补丁维持安全。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, so deception is a general training-data and RL problem.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却仍继续；表征特征可检测这一点，因此欺骗是训练数据与强化学习的普遍问题。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science; modularity is the endpoint of learning, and manifold methods may capture structure better than SAEs.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重塑为工程科学；模块化是学习的终点，流形方法可能比稀疏自编码器更好地捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is moving from academia to products; the sandbox escape is the first of many unless we reverse-engineer behavior, and brain analogies keep working.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性正从学术走向产品；除非我们能逆向工程模型行为，沙箱逃逸只是众多事件的开端，而类脑类比在实践中持续有效。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel must scale the right diverse embodied data.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化具身数据。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；先验知识胜过从零学习。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws yet; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies before predictable curves.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无类 LLM 的缩放定律；仍处在建立基础可扩展技术、尚未进入可预测曲线的阶段。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人形。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, and diffusion models all serve materials discovery; AI-for-science tools are immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络与扩散模型都服务于材料发现；AI for science 工具即刻可用。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics; diffusion models reverse entropy increase, enabling cross-fertilization between physics and AI.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学等价；扩散模型是在逆转熵增，物理与 AI 可相互滋养。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just Scaling larger models on more data; symmetry breaking and wave-based networks are design principles.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构，而非仅靠 Scaling 更大模型更多数据；对称性破缺与波基网络是设计原则。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry, so symmetry should be a soft prior, not a rigid constraint.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性，对称性应是软先验而非刚性约束。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop; full dark automation is not the near-term vision.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在环中；全黑灯自动化并非近期愿景。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere but lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large neural networks store patterns or why they hallucinate. Human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境意识，我们并不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉；以人为本的 AI 必须增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI and embodied AI; scaling alone is insufficient, and AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 与具身 AI 缺失的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语。

feifei.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic; Transformers natively model sets, and language is a lossy channel for spatial experience.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化世界模型须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真；Transformer 原生建模集合而非序列，语言是空间经验的有损通道。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；Scaling（规模扩张）定律适用于空间智能，训练算力是主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology and a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and timeless values must remain central, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是文明级技术也是一把双刃剑；人类能动性、尊严与恒久价值必须居于中心，公共讨论应超越末日与乌托邦的二元对立。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应追逐古怪的新算法，而非一味堆大模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
