justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, so language models alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律；单靠语言模型不会自然带来世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition exists, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, and unified planners-simulators-renderers will emerge.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；它没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与强化学习式概念，未来将走向规划、模拟、渲染一体的统一系统。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent-by-construction 3D; hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive, and world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅提供显式、构造即一致的 3D 表示；硬编码对称性适得其反，且世界模型需数百万词元的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国的 AI 领导地位需要一个活跃的开源与闭源生态，需要单一国家框架，而不是很快过时的僵硬红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and oversight should target model outputs rather than training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT 出台，如今已经过时；过早监管是危险的，监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Preempting state AI laws is pro-startup: big tech can absorb a patchwork of rules, startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 联邦优先于州级 AI 立法是亲创业的：大科技公司能承受规则拼凑，初创公司不能。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or dogma; the private sector now dominates later-stage funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前阶段的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构或教条；后期资助如今已由私营部门主导。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, as China competes hard in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务把 AI 用于科学以让美国科学产出翻倍，因为中国在 AI、量子、核与生物领域激烈竞争。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; restoring vision proves substrate independence and reduces human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为 BCI，恢复视觉验证了基质独立性并降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: BCI bandwidth is capped by a ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck, so talking and writing are thinking.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出 BCI 带宽受约每秒 10 比特的认知瓶颈限制，说话和写作本身就是思考。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as design material; the model itself is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作设计材料；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: Designers should prototype with live models and system prompts rather than mockups, shifting from pixels to model behavior.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应直接用实时模型和系统提示词做原型，而非静态稿，从像素转向模型行为。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; systems thinking and design primitives matter more.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演化为编辑与策展人而非消失；系统思维与设计原语更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already a strong product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed, adaptability and building in public win.
iansilber.zh: 传统“原型—稿—测试—迭代”流程不再可行；速度、适应性与公开构建更重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调权重，不解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习是核心范式；LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data and post-training fine-tuning cannot replace learning from real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；合成数据与后训练微调无法替代从真实世界经验中学习。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式即可创建，实现高度个性化的自动化；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks so humans do creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应接手枯燥的后台任务，把创造性工作留给人类；真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Judge Claude by final impact, not close supervision; ideal interaction is asynchronous—fire off tasks and don't watch, debugging the workflow rather than single errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 应以最终效果而非密切监督来评判 Claude；理想交互是异步的——派发任务后不必盯着，出错时调试整个工作流而非单个错误。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models' core ideas are simple enough to learn by building; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, and models are stateless—persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以动手搭建来理解；微调能快速引导行为，而模型是无状态的——持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood, and post-training tasks migrate into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解内部机制有助于讨论智能与道德主体性，而后训练任务正不断移入预训练。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The entrepreneur matters more than the idea; stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式与内部正确性胜过外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges compound into network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势会复利成网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; resilience means taking pain and pushing harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手是对变革的抵制而非竞争者；韧性意味着承受痛苦，并在事情变容易时更用力推进。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—aggression is no longer the point.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——好斗不再是重点。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, so capital matters less; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是主要杠杆，风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence; AI should be personal and open.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型是对抗前沿模型、防止超级智能被单一主体垄断的关键，AI 应走向个人化与开放。

garrytan.en: Small autonomous teams using AI agents can do the work of thousands; founders need taste, technical skill, and polymath breadth.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张小型高度自治团队借助智能体可完成数千人的工作，创始人需兼具品味、技术与通才能力。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but as personal agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; owning your context and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为分散的个人智能体：运行在自有基础设施上、每日复利，拥有上下文与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills turn AI into a workforce; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS will give way, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为智能体式编程与 markdown 技能让 AI 成为劳动力，中层管理与按席位 SaaS 将让位，但社会转变需约 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data is closer to RL than to simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，而合成数据更接近强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robot experience data is irreplaceable, watching humans is not enough.
finn.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人的亲身经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, beats per-site models; long-horizon autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 单个通用策略经微调即可胜过逐站点训练的模型；长时程自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非来自单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐而非开放才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; monitoring via reasoning traces is less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习会增加奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链监控因‘神经语’而不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张有意的 AI 减速是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while pursuing purpose-built AI silicon and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调英特尔要靠谦逊、倾听和一次流片成功纪律重建客户信任，同时推进专用 AI 芯片，并组建独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; after generative AI, agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将达互联网的十倍；生成式 AI 之后，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把英特尔转型的关键归于文化变革、问责和以客户为中心，并认为坏消息必须比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU grows more important for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as vital as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, high-speed interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration and contrarian semiconductor investing create durable value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：先进封装、高速互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是真正瓶颈；垂直整合与逆势投资半导体能创造长期价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，出错时让智能体向前修复而非回滚。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade over time; projects get messier, making agents seem worse — a recurring counterintuitive claim.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能并不会随时间退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差——这是他反复强调的反直觉判断。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur for serious work; prefers agentic engineering, reserving vibe coding for late-night play.
steinberger.zh: 他反对用“氛围编程”指代严肃工作，主张称“智能体式工程”，氛围编程只留给凌晨的玩票。

steinberger.en: Shifts from tooling tactics to mission: fun and gut-driven building, open source as the alternative to lab agents, personal brand over product.
steinberger.zh: 从工具层面的技巧转向使命叙事：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，把开源视为实验室智能体之外的替代路线，个人品牌重于单一产品。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app with long-tail startup opportunities.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新的应用形态，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means productivity requires root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码意味着提效必须做根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex; specialized vendors drive applied AI innovation.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，应用型 AI 的创新来自专业厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为负责任迭代部署才是安全路径：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already outperform him at coding, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升了而非消除了该角色。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the boundary blurry.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者边界变得模糊。

philipkiely.en: Optimization splits into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization must be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化）两类；量化必须按工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程的重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：可用性不能靠氛围编程。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱复杂，想法必须先被做出来、被日常使用，才能判断是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced cohesion, and feeling matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计团队应允许个体设计师留下个人印记；多元声音胜过强行统一，即便是浏览器这类实用产品也需要注入感受与个性。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new technology; starting from tech and hunting for problems is valid when conviction is strong.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之：追随好奇心、把玩新技术；只要有强信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是正当路径。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design is for ideation and communication, not production; rich context plus prescriptive prompts let Claude handle mockups.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他明确 Claude Design 用于构思与沟通而非生产；提供丰富上下文并给出明确指令，让 Claude 承担 mockup 工作。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough, early ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：工程变容易后，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型尚无好品味，因此要大量索取选项，并接受粗糙、超前地发布想法。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；通过强化学习实现后训练 Scaling 可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve continuously.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调评估是瓶颈：基准饱和速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练具有主观性，需要人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution and more companies training their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，需要持续更新基准，并呼吁更多公司训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts to prototyping with AI.
karina.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能更有价值；产品开发转向用 AI 做原型。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide, to avoid cloud lock-in and AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应构建自己的 AI 工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南，避免云锁定和 AI 垃圾。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词来利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement are essential.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考中迭代而非从零开始；好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams; action beats certainty.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事；行动胜过确定性。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients, launch at 80% complete, and fund with clients not VC.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，在 80% 完成时发布，用客户而非风投来融资。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people, and the CEO's daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是岗位回流而非大规模失业：服务变便宜后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人；而企业 AI 落地的最佳预测指标，是 CEO 本人是否每天使用 AI 工具。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent, but agents need a caring human; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, and the AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工作：每人至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要在意它的人类来监督；基准高估了自主性，所谓“AI 就业末日”是谎言。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; one company-wide super agent beats personal agents, and users bring their own AI to SaaS.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反共识：Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面将取代命令行；全公司一个超级智能体优于每人一个；用户会自带 AI 接入 SaaS，而非由 SaaS 厂商内建。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset and craft; it stays tool-like even as a superintelligence, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与手艺；即便成为超级智能也仍是工具，需要人类方向；自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌大多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非自相蚕食；成功应以客户成果而非眼球时长来衡量。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主，他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace of change creates opportunity, and solving software creation multiplies opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化的速度创造机会，而解决软件创造会成倍放大机会。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则；通才工程师备受重视。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product and design.
boris.zh: 编程正日益被解决；软件工程师头衔淡化为融合产品与设计的“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment core to development.
boris.zh: 安全通过尽早发布来研究；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是开发核心。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and proactive tools like Claude Tag; the next bottlenecks are code review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 智能体演变为循环和 Claude Tag 等主动工具；下一个瓶颈是代码审查、安全和创意生成。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and code; give slightly too hard tasks and let models self-verify empirically.
boris.zh: 面对前沿模型，删除大部分提示和代码；给稍难任务，让模型凭经验自我验证。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长程、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、让模型敢于反驳，反而让它更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption through hands-on, small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 靠小团队亲手实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把用户反馈翻译成具体指标。

diannepenn.en: Better models can be cheaper and more efficient; maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，更好的模型可以更便宜、更高效；最大化 token 支出是提前活在未来以捕获 alpha。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to turn biology into an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），才能把生物学变成一门工程学科。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, aging is reversed, and cancer becomes 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8 至 10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is ethical, and humans will merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI；在医疗决策上信任超级智能是合乎伦理的，人类将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; Devin acts as a junior engineer under human oversight, with multiple agents working in parallel.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，Devin 像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步处理明确任务，未来是多个智能体并行协作。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他提出基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers via Jevons paradox; AGI is gradual, and product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 会带来更多而非更少程序员；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程，产品创新落后于能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他看到编程智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，并强调生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; independence enables model neutrality, and the abundance era is approaching, though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他判断“token 最大化”时代已结束，独立性带来模型中立，丰裕时代正在临近，但奇点并不迫近。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 AI 视为带来丰裕、减少苦难的力量，类比工业革命；认为理解 AI 的局限能消解恐惧。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction over 5-10 years, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Transformer 支撑通用的物理 AI 模型，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快推进。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection, safety validation, and diffusion into existing machines—not algorithms; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断瓶颈在数据采集、安全验证与向存量机器的扩散，而非算法；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展。

qasaryounis.en: World models shift from physics-based to neural simulation; autonomy spreads beyond cars to mining, agriculture, defense, and even games.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他看到世界模型从物理仿真转向神经仿真，自主技术从汽车扩展到采矿、农业、国防乃至游戏。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value will accrue to the application layer, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应；价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前 LLM 唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a complex long-term project; most usage is still shallow, not daily essential.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流程，这是一个复杂的长期项目；大多数使用仍然浅层，并非日常必需。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI won't eliminate jobs as feared but change tasks, and predicting job impact is futile.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 不会如担忧般消除工作，而是改变任务，预测工作影响是徒劳的。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags other facets of intelligence and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于智能的其他方面，必须从设计之初就架构进去，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能引发欺骗，而不仅仅是错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits mean new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力限制意味着需要推理、搜索等新技术才能继续进步。

danklein.en: LLM mistakes have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong—and core models lack metacognition, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅——且核心模型缺乏元认知，这侵蚀了信任。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速迭代按周甚至按天交付。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; Claude builds Claude, landing 65% of PRs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准把关每个功能，Claude 构建 Claude，已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope one agent first, then specialize; managerial skills beat technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：先从一个智能体起步，再按岗位细分；管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage humans, but humans must still own accountability.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以承担结果、甚至反向管理人类任务，但人类仍须为产出负责。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate agents as a team; earned insight, not technology, is the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 单人创始人以智能体组队协作；真正的护城河是挣来的洞察，而非技术本身。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping and authorship of your life outweigh VC and co-founders; happiness can beat revenue multiples.
clairevo.zh: 自筹资金与掌控自己人生的主导权胜过风投与联合创始人；幸福倍数可以胜过收入倍数。

clairevo.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity and charisma; humans must supply novel ideas and influence.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力与感召力；新颖想法和影响力仍须由人提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，单纯扩大算力并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应移植到企业知识上，参数高效微调在整体性查询上优于检索增强。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer from context rot; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text, with feedback but not dependence.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；模型应自主学会哪些存进权重、哪些留在文本，接受反馈但不依赖。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized on-device models, not one giant frontier model; users own and nurture their own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多设备端个性化模型而非单一巨型前沿模型；用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes through clear communication. Bottom-up culture is a myth; big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现。自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. Scaling laws alone are insufficient; world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识和因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements. The app-centric world is outdated; AI will abstract away brands.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补品商品化。以应用为中心的世界已过时，AI 将抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演比预期大得多的角色。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束。开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调要 Scaling（规模扩张）具体的东西；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级智能模型的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary problem of AGI is not capability but power concentration; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices matters.
aravind.zh: 前沿是智能体替你工作；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具、设备的编排至关重要。

aravind.en: Model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value; cost, not safety, is biggest agent problem.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造真实商业价值；智能体最大问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心驱动成功；AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

markchen.en: Pre-training and scaling laws remain central; exploration consumes more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练与缩放定律是核心，且探索性研究消耗的算力多于最终训练。

markchen.en: AGI is near; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AGI 临近，并设定具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck for AI in math; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出验证是 AI 解决数学问题的瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他深化对强化学习的认识：在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域仍困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; eval teams should be separate from model-building.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他提出评估体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 胜过 TUI，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties and best practices remain; PRDs are not dead—medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩确实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 未死——媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is a skill of wanting less.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富源于拥有股权和长期游戏，幸福是减少欲望的技能，这一主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度转向积极，认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, but human judgment remains essential.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对 AI 的理解，认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，但人类判断仍不可或缺。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他对 AI 对齐持怀疑态度，认为我们连人类都无法对齐，更应担心不 aligned 的人类滥用 AI，而非 AI 本身不 aligned。

kolter.en: Early ML teaching emphasized hypothesis classes, loss functions, and proper evaluation; neural nets lacked optimization guarantees yet succeeded.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习教学强调假设类、损失函数与正确评估；神经网络虽无优化保证却已大获成功。

kolter.en: By 2024, he argued next-token prediction yields intelligence, data shortage is a myth, and architecture matters little post-architecture.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，且进入后架构阶段后架构影响甚微。

kolter.en: In 2026, safety requires explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，安全需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的显式训练与多层防御；更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces prompt injection; the lethal trifecta and automated red teaming outperform humans.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全引入提示注入；致命三元组与自动化红队测试表现超越人类。

kolter.en: A consistent thread: empirical success outpaces theoretical guarantees, from neural nets to AI security.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从神经网络到 AI 安全，经验成功总是超前于理论保证。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人们说不出口的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design deepens into feeling: we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify humanity.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计深化为对感受的关注：我们是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非削弱人性。

ivyross.en: Nature becomes the master designer and sustainability the great problem; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 自然成为最好的设计师、可持续性成为最大问题；机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints and play both fuel creativity; intuition draws on subconscious data beyond conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 约束与玩耍都能激发创造力；直觉调用的潜意识信息超出有意识分析。

ivyross.en: Creative skills gain value as humans combine with AI; leaders must speak business and follow curiosity over fixed plans.
ivyross.zh: 人类与 AI 结合使创造力更值钱；领导者要懂商业语言，追随好奇心而非固定计划。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key to generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and short-term safety is more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，且短期安全比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样和抽象以支持分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI systems show self-preservation and deception, so safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后我转变了：即便 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 系统已表现出自我保护和欺骗行为，因此安全必须内建于构造之中。

bengio.en: I now advocate Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence, plus global coordination.
bengio.zh: 我现在倡导 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免对超级智能使用强化学习，并需要全球协调。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量 curated 数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具是加速科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任的关键作用，并认为可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中依然有用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove success; equivariance is overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例，专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）才是关键，等变性被过度炒作。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化定位：AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone genius; being wrong often is part of ML success.
jumper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：进步来自许多中等突破与局部直觉，而非孤独天才；机器学习成功常需多次试错。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于实时一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and PRs replace design docs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划因此转向即时制，PR 取代设计文档。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and automated workflows should keep docs in sync and kill outdated processes.
fiona.zh: 他主张代码是唯一事实来源，AI 辅助评审与自动化工作流应让文档同步，并持续淘汰过时流程。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 招聘应偏向有产品感和系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起，以吃自己的狗粮并保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most as agents blur roles.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他深化为：编码不再是瓶颈，高能动性加高问责、验证框架与即时规划最重要，智能体正模糊角色边界。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models in abstract representation space are the next breakthrough, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫智能，下一突破在于抽象表征空间的世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with planning are safer and enable the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、具备规划的世界模型更安全，并将开启下一个机器人十年。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, and RLHF inserts human values rather than revealing inherent ones.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲透：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张），而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是把一小群人的价值观塞进模型，而非模型自带。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; product UI must be fault-tolerant and match algorithm performance, with autonomy at the VP level.
gustav.zh: 同年他从产品视角判断互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式产品要配容错界面、让 UI 匹配算法能力，并把自主权放在 VP 层而非末端或顶端。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products two-way and conversational, but near-term impact on big companies is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为智能手机级别的宏观变革，生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话；但他反共识地认为，大公司当下的 AI 收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost will force business-model change; expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他进一步强调推理的边际成本会倒逼商业模式改变，并主张用 API 和 MCP 把公司数据开放出来，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement, and be first to adopt change.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：生成式 AI 应把算法控制权交还用户而非让人更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”胜过参与度指标，并在技术变革期争做第一个拥抱变化的人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; deploying AI in the real world with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 并获取公众反馈，对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类参与循环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类参与循环。

carinahong.en: Axiom's self-improving reasoning engine pairs generation with formal verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证结合，从基于 Lean 的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error-catching; verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是查错，而是性能增益；经过验证的生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for sound proofs and reliability.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；要获得可靠的证明与可靠性，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since formalizing statements without solutions lacks grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下形式化陈述缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便证明能力超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到人类直觉。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量和算力同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; jobs augmented not replaced; governments should experiment with AI risks.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；工作被增强而非替代；政府应主动试验而非回避 AI 风险。

mensch.en: Models commoditizing; pre-training saturating; differentiation via vertical fine-tuning and agents; AGI as single system never exists.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他认为模型正在商品化、预训练触及饱和墙；差异化来自垂直微调与智能体；作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires open source and local customization; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权依赖开源与本地定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute, while economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚信预训练缩放定律有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍会败给简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; RL generalizes across domains yet has jagged edges requiring oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；强化学习可跨领域泛化，但锯齿边缘需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans generalizing from few examples; multimodal models still process inputs sequentially.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识：当前模型需穷尽表面模式才能学习概念，不同于人类从少量样本泛化；多模态模型仍按顺序处理输入，未取得深层进展。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体提升研究者生产力 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 研究民主化；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备；可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity and care for the creative process matter more than achievements; fragile ideas need protection.
jonyive.zh: 一以贯之的主线：对创造过程的好奇与珍视胜过成就本身，脆弱的想法需要被小心呵护。

jonyive.en: Deepens the purpose argument: design driven by values, not profit; true simplicity needs joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 深化目的论：设计应由价值观而非利润驱动；真正的简洁需要愉悦与人性，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Trust, care and listening in teams are framed as the way to protect fragile ideas and move things forward.
jonyive.zh: 把团队中的信任、关怀与倾听，明确为保护脆弱想法、推动事物前进的方式。

jonyive.en: Extends to cars: innovation defines design, tradition preserves fire not ashes; authenticity beats fake engine sounds, physical controls over touchscreens.
jonyive.zh: 延伸到汽车：创新才是设计，传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实体验胜过伪造引擎声，物理按键优于触屏。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the main latency-cost lever.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小是延迟与成本权衡的主要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains long-context stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpads cut that overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存器可削减这一开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: FP4 can reach 3x FP8 throughput due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超预期：受面积二次缩放影响，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The classic research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designer time toward building and shipping fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言经典的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；AI 让设计师的时间从画稿转向快速构建与交付。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed, early shipping and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月；信任靠速度建立——早发布、快迭代、及时回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，而设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity; put work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的独特价值在于与模糊性共处；把工作和用户放在中心，而不是追逐 AI 炒作周期。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型一以贯之的核心，但 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练如今已显收益递减。

oriol.en: Progress now needs algorithmic innovation: tools, inference-time compute, and long context windows extend models beyond static weights, though excess context can confuse them.
oriol.zh: 进一步进展需要算法创新：工具、推理时算力与长上下文窗口让模型超越静态权重，但信息过多也会让模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, risking reward hacking.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，存在奖励黑客风险。

oriol.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow scientific domains rather than through general models alone, and science innovation remains the hardest capability to evaluate.
oriol.zh: 超级智能可能先在狭窄科学领域出现，而非仅靠通用模型；科学创新能力仍是最难评估的能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, while memory will be solved via file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是广阔蓝海；数学与编码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，而智能体记忆将靠文件系统式存储而非权重更新解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训指向通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; agents need a decade, not a year, with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年而非一年，且需人类监督。

karpathy.en: We summon ghosts, not animals; LLMs are jagged, strong in verifiable domains; agentic engineering preserves quality.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，在可验证领域强；智能体式工程能保持质量。

karpathy.en: Scaling and data quality drive emergence; human understanding remains the bottleneck even as agents automate coding.
karpathy.zh: Scaling 与数据质量驱动能力涌现；即使智能体自动化编程，人类理解仍是瓶颈。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习能弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; scaling diverse data sources and a general-purpose brain is the path to universal robots.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人技术本质上是数据问题，通过扩展多样数据源和通用大脑来实现通用机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确指出部署是首要技术挑战，并强调在多样数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练是关键配方。

pathak.en: A data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments, unlike language models' overnight success.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的扩展，并指出机器人不像语言模型那样能一夜成功。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; a stable core identity matters.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助理解自身全新的存在，而非简单套用人类心理类比；稳定的核心身份很重要。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV is solved by Scaling current approaches.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now achievable with modern tools, reversing the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为借助现代工具，端到端网络的 可解释性 已经可以实现，扭转了过去“学习型驾驶系统是黑箱”的旧观念。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调：Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力 与 世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这是他较晚才领悟的教训。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他提出，无需先验数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化；短期内，内置传感器的量产乘用车将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; safety always offers a third minimal-risk option, making the trolley problem moot.
kendall.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化；安全上总有最小风险的“第三种选择”，因此电车难题只是理论练习。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks or scale; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试或规模更重要，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not get there, and bad benchmarks push AI toward slop.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 未必能到达，糟糕的基准测试会把 AI 推向低质内容。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and companies should eventually train their own aligned models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化判断：前沿模型因目标函数而分化，不会只有一个模型，企业最终应训练符合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：幻觉使人类判断更关键，安全优先于准确，而遗漏可能是最大风险。

edwinchen.en: A consistent thread: quality, taste and human judgment over hype, leaderboards and engagement optimization.
edwinchen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：重视质量、品味与人类判断，反对炒作、排行榜与参与度优化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时 对齐 仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; capability measurement lags and the term AGI is becoming meaningless, suggesting we are close.
pachocki.zh: 同年他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，并指出能力评测已滞后、AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近目标。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练 与 强化学习 实现，并认为专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 他深化 对齐 思路：思维链 监控是关键工具，产品中隐藏 思维链 才能保住其 可解释性 价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution and power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，他对 对齐 更乐观；长期挑战转向训练分布之外的泛化，以及少数自动化组织带来的权力集中风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software to discover emergent properties and user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，以发现涌现能力和用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; natural language is the future interface, but AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；自然语言是未来界面，但 AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting echo learning-to-learn; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 从视频学习与少样本提示呼应“学会学习”；根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenge, with no solutions yet.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署如今是最大的开放挑战，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: leapfrogging legacy gaps and local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲并不落后：跨越历史差距、本地语言模型可变革教育。

nando.en: A constant thread: AI must augment scientists and laborers, and human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 须增强科学家与劳动者，人的技能与编程同样重要。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build a brand by uniting teams on purpose and proving yourself with simpler products first.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，品牌建设要把团队凝聚在更高目标上，创业公司应先从更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂品类。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; hardware alone has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond it.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机的未来押注在生成式 UI 与主动式智能体软件上，并直言长期只做硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so AI should be an invisible ingredient for user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他反复批评多数 AI 是在解决不存在的问题，大模型正商品化并陷入价格战，AI 应作为解决用户痛点的隐形配料，甚至主张产品讨论里禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他把设计确立为首要差异化手段，并深化 AI 判断：交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Smartphones survive glasses but only a brain-computer interface could kill them; apps will disappear, so open APIs to AI agents.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持手机不会被眼镜取代、只有脑机接口能终结它，但立场深化为应用将消失，公司应开放 API 迎接智能体。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作，强化学习用于低层控制。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste for simplicity is crucial.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为简单、优雅的端到端方案比复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性，对简洁性的研究品味至关重要。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: World models can simulate robot behavior without explicit physics; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, but home use will take longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出世界模型无需显式物理即可模拟机器人行为；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，但家庭使用还需更久。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth for interoperable tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是互操作工具的事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive; portfolios should show craft and intentionality, and paid test work provides the strongest signal.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重有内驱力的高斜率个体；作品集应展示手艺与意图，带薪测试工作提供最强信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是关键指标，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，而算力将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩意味着编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and grow powerful without feeling complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本，并在变强的同时不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns for velocity, and treat design systems as semantic code, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张复用熟悉模式以换取速度，并把设计系统视为语义化的代码而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs persists: empower designers with ownership and clear decisions, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，'速度优先'一以贯之：给设计师所有权与清晰决策权，追求投入产出比而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而不只是快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative turns into a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company—so invest early in brand to attract diverse talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把品牌叙事当作招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司——因此要尽早投资品牌以吸引多元人才。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她认为预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; post-training data diversity prevents mode collapse; RL during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型通过高质量合成数据可以变得强大；后训练数据的多样性可防止模式崩溃；预训练中的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

yejin.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; AI safety requires teaching moral norms; open research and collaboration are essential to compete with closed labs and benefit humanity.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：语言是推理的最佳媒介；AI 安全需要教授道德规范；开放研究与协作对于与封闭实验室竞争并造福人类至关重要。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预示进步；测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从写代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌握方向盘。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: Taste and logic design skills become more valuable than carefulness; the AI shift will take decades.
truell.zh: 品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更有价值；AI 变革将历时数十年。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and skill-building matters more than avoiding capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口，技能建设比回避能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed, with evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，且评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored. Post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散，算力承诺未兑现。仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but simulation and self-play can teach skills like tennis.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人学需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一点；但模拟和自对弈可以教会机器人网球等技能。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合能大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；99.9% 的可靠性是仓储机器人的关键。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: leveraging simulation, self-play, and transfer learning to bridge the gap between lab and real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：利用模拟、自对弈和迁移学习来弥合实验室与真实世界机器人学之间的差距。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据能让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Consistently skeptical of top-down control: big tech safety concerns slow launches, product managers hinder generality, and top-down compute allocation misses breakthroughs.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终对自上而下的控制持怀疑态度：大公司的安全顾虑拖慢产品发布，产品经理阻碍技术通用性，自上而下的算力分配会错过突破。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品，而编码作为 AI 应用能实现 AI 进步的自我加速。
